description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering leave request searches in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. classes.name: LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for defining filtering parameters for leave request searches, including statuses, employee info, subunit, leave type, and inclusion options, with validation logic.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses set for filtering.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses for filtering, validating against allowed statuses.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets multiple employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the inclusion option for employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion option for employees.
